premises.text: Government policy is still communicated through unstructured text, so citizens do not engage
premises.evidence_span: For centuries, we've been creating and communicating government policies through unstructured text documents like these.

premises.text: Policy stakes are personal and large, yet changes remain barely influenced and loosely understood by the public
premises.evidence_span: New government policy changes our income about $4,000 each year.

premises.text: A model of the US economy built from millions of tax returns and census records projects policy impacts on real people
premises.evidence_span: we've been merging millions of tax returns and census records to create a model of the US economy

premises.text: Users see personal and community impacts of any policy down to the zip-code level
premises.evidence_span: load up a full simulation of every single resident in the state

premises.text: Users can configure their own policy scenarios, from tax rates to budget line items, and compute impacts in real time
premises.evidence_span: it'll calculate this new rate against the spending patterns of over 6 million people

premises.text: Endorsements are recorded on government analytics, shaping policy around what people want
premises.evidence_span: this response gets recorded on the government's analytics, helping them shape policies around what people want

premises.text: Incumbent government analysis tools are inaccessible and cost millions; Outline is a turnkey, cheaper replacement
premises.evidence_span: Outline, though, is a turnkey solution that not only saves governments money, but produces better governing.

value.text: Citizens participate in government directly, intelligently, and easily
value.evidence_span: we're making participation in government direct, intelligent, and easy

secondary_value.text: Governments save money and produce better governing
secondary_value.evidence_span: not only saves governments money, but produces better governing

causal_links.evidence_span: create a model of the US economy, where you can configure government policies and then see their projected impacts on real people
most of us just don't have the patience to engage. But it does matter.
you can configure government policies and then see their projected impacts on real people
helping them shape policies around what people want

notes: Prior election-forecast tool (4 million uses in 90 days) and the Massachusetts procurement win excluded as traction per 4.2. Personal, map, and scenario simulations are kept as separate premises here because each names a distinct capability claim (per-person projection, full-population mapping, user-driven parameter changes); the 'create any vision of government' line treated as part of the scenario-design premise, not vision framing. Government cost savings recorded as secondary value.
